_comment: SmartCuff GUI update manifest. Fetched by the installed GUI over plain
public HTTPS -- there is deliberately NO credential in the client. See
README.md for why an embedded token was rejected.
This file is the ONLY thing the updater needs to read. Keep it small and
keep it valid JSON: a malformed manifest must fail soft in the client, but
there is no reason to rely on that.
The installer is a GitHub Release asset rather than a repository blob.
Keep installer_url version-specific: an existing manifest must always
resolve to the exact immutable bytes whose size and SHA-256 it declares.
notes: Use live device Cal 2 to stop pump and vent at the calibrated 250 mmHg raw ADC voltage, capped by the existing independent 4 V interlock. Device D threshold is 3.88567 V. SysID requires fresh device-bound calibration before inflation, blocks targets at or above 250 mmHg, and stops on invalid or changed calibration/ADC. Terminal SysID raw acquisition evidence is saved before secondary analysis; fits wait for verified safe cleanup or remain deferred. Both branches compiled, passed 395 focused checks each, 47 additional preset/trap/abort checks each, layout CLEAN and smoke. Protected snapshot/flash/restore and ten-minute bench checks: Default 6/6, 26340/26340 Arduino=100%, 314660 NI samples; Valinor 7/7, 20281/20281 Arduino=100% in trial windows, 340610 NI samples. NI gaps/backtracks=0. Existing control profiles and calibration coefficients are preserved. Startup ramp tracking, physical pulse preservation, achieved Smart Const MAP+5 pressure, and full-band/device SysID repeatability remain under investigation; experimental controller or tuning changes are not included.
_channel_note: stable is the only channel today. If a test channel is ever added, publish
a second manifest (version-beta.json) rather than adding branching logic to
the client -- the client stays a dumb fetch-and-compare.
